solutions.text: We will use the identities \(\cos a+\cos b=2 \cos \frac{a+b}{2} \cos \frac{a-b}{2}\) and \(\sin a+\sin b=\) \(2 \sin \frac{a+b}{2} \cos \frac{a+b}{2}\). The numerator is \((\sin 10+\sin 80)+(\sin 20+\sin 70)+(\sin 30+\sin 60)+(\sin 40+\) \(\sin 60)=2 \sin 45(\cos 35+\cos 25+\cos 15+\cos 35)=2 \sin 45((\cos 35+\cos 5)+(\cos 25+\cos 15))=\) \(4 \sin 45 \cos 20(\cos 15+\cos 5)=8 \sin 45 \cos 20 \cos 10 \cos 5\), so the fraction equals \(8 \sin 45=4 \sqrt{2}\).
